name: powertrace
description: PowerTrace: a live dependency graph of a building's electrical system on MongoDB Atlas

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix screen install && npm --prefix bot install && npm --prefix data install && npm --prefix mock install
scripts.test: npm --prefix data test && npm --prefix mock test
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix mock ci && npm --prefix screen ci --include=dev && npm --prefix screen run build
